name: Nursing
notice: Education, not clinical authorisation. NurseGradify doesn't give NMC registration, replace approved practice placements or assess your competence. Practise clinical skills and give medicines only within your scope, under supervision where required, and following your local policies. NMC standards apply UK-wide; laws, policies and services that differ between England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are labelled.

paths.name: Adult nursing
paths.sub: The shared core, then adult nursing across medical, surgical and community settings, acute and critical care, older adults and end-of-life care, with field scenarios, placement preparation and reflection.

paths.name: Children's nursing
paths.sub: The shared core, then children's and young people's nursing: development, family-centred care, consent and parental responsibility, safeguarding, paediatric assessment, neonates, childhood conditions and medicines safety.

paths.name: Mental health nursing
paths.sub: The shared core, then mental health nursing: assessment, therapeutic relationships, conditions, risk and crisis, mental health and capacity law, de-escalation and recovery, with physical health care for people with mental illness.

paths.name: Learning disability nursing
paths.sub: The shared core, then learning disability nursing: communication, reasonable adjustments, capacity and advocacy, positive behaviour support, health inequalities, epilepsy and complex needs, families and inclusion.

paths.name: Pre-registration year 1 (all fields)
paths.sub: Professional practice, the body, assessment and core skills: the foundations every field of nursing builds on.

paths.name: Recognising and responding to deterioration
paths.sub: Assessment, observations, escalation, acute and critical care, and the conditions behind deterioration.

paths.name: Medicines management
paths.sub: Pharmacology, the administration process, calculations and medicines safety. Education only: you give medicines under your local policy and supervision.

paths.name: Newly qualified nurse
paths.sub: Accountability, delegation, prioritisation, escalation, medicines safety and handover for your first post.

paths.name: Internationally educated nurses: UK practice
paths.sub: The NMC Code, UK law and policy across the four nations, assessment conventions and medicines governance in the UK.

paths.name: Nursing associates
paths.sub: The foundations for nursing associates, within the NMC's standards of proficiency for nursing associates and your local scope.

paths.name: CPD and revalidation
paths.sub: Refresh professional standards, evidence-based practice, leadership and medicines knowledge, and record it as CPD.

interactives.title: The quiet patient in bay 3
interactives.sub: A post-operative patient deteriorates: assess with ABCDE, score NEWS2 as the observations change, and escalate with SBAR.
interactives.note: A fictional patient with scripted observations; decisions follow the ABCDE approach and NEWS2 (RCP, 2017). Educational only: follow your organisation's policy in practice.

interactives.title: NEWS2 scoring practice
interactives.sub: Score generated sets of adult observations parameter by parameter and choose the clinical response.
interactives.note: Generated adult observations scored on the RCP NEWS2 chart (2017), oxygen scale 1. Educational only: use your organisation's chart and escalation policy.

interactives.title: Medicines calculations
interactives.sub: Tablets, liquids, infusion and drip rates, unit conversions and weight-based doses, with worked methods. Illustrative numbers only.
interactives.note: Generated questions with invented medicines and round numbers: numeracy practice, not dosing advice.
